title: Finite tensor pullback composition on flat K-flat representatives
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $n\geq0$ and composable scheme morphisms $h:Z\to X$, $f:X\to Y$, with $\ell$ invertible on all three schemes. Use the intrinsic operations and canonical comparison of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. For any flat-term K-flat cochain complexes $P,Q$ on $Y$, let $M=Q_Y(P)$, $N=Q_Y(Q)$, $F=f^*$, $H=h^*$, $K=(h\gg f)^*$ at the finite derived level and $c:K\simeq FH$ the specified compositor sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp of [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square]. Then $\mu_{h\gg f;M,N}\,(c_M\otimes c_N)=c_{M\otimes N}\,H(\mu_{f;M,N})\,\mu_{h;FM,FN}$, composed in traversal order. Only the localized flat K-flat pairs are asserted here.

proof.text: Use the proved single-pullback representative square for f,h,h≫f, applying the h square to the ordinary pullbacks of P,Q. Pasting the first two squares uses naturality of the finite tensor comparison and gives the normalized square for the iterated pullback.

The exact-derived functor compositor and natural-isomorphism factorization formulas identify sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp with the termwise compositor conjugated by the three finite realization maps. Cancel the three realization isomorphisms in the computation maps. This is the proved compositor_fac calculation.

Apply the ordinary chain-composition identity. Naturality of the fixed tensor representative comparison identifies its image under Q with the tensor of the two localized compositor components. Cancel the source representative isomorphism and the two iterated computation isomorphisms; the remaining equality is the required representative coherence. The normalized_tensor_square helper performs these cancellations explicitly.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePullbackTensor_composition_representatives {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
    (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) Q) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q
    ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ Z Y (h ≫ f) n hZ hY) M N).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Z n).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) h f).hom.app M)
          ((sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) h f).hom.app N)) =
    (sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) h f).hom.app
        ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Y n).obj (M,N)) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n h).map
        ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY) M N).hom ≫
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ Z X h n hZ hX)
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj M)
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj N)).hom
